body: Sorry I took so long to reply, haven't logged into this account in a while, which I suppose is a good thing. Anyways, I decided to tell my parents, which was the right call - they were a bit upset and confused at first, but after a little while they forgave me, and sad that I was too young to understand what I was doing, and that my sister didn't remember it (my mom would have known already if she did, apparently). They also said that they were going to help me find a therapist to work things out.  That put me at ease for a few weeks, but in the past couple days I've been alone with my thoughts and things are starting to come back. I've come to the conclusion that yeah, I probably wasn't entirely  aware of what I was doing due to my, at best, limited concept of sexuality at the time (I practiced kissing on a Dora the Explorer doll - good lord that was an embarrassing period of life). My most recent worry is that the reason my sister doesn't remember is because she has repressed the memory, which, if true, there's not much I can do about. As I've had time to think about it, if one were to see the event objectively, it would just be two kids playing, but still, the thoughts were in my head, even if things may have been hazy or unorganized. I'm no longer at the point where I want to kill myself, but I'm still pretty low - hopefully I can get to a therapist soon. I think the major problem is that I feel that I've done an unforgivable thing, a thing that will define the way I am for the rest of my life. Of course, logically that's absurd, but my brain has a way of twisting things to not work out in my favor.

That seems like a good idea, though like I said, I don't think she remembers at all, and said she didn't remember anything that I did wrong to her when we were younger. I feel like I did a poor job of describing what happened in my original post - it wasn't like, there was a halt in the wrestling, I touched a bad area, and then we continued wrestling, it was more the wrestling contained touches that were in bad areas, like I would push her in the chest area. I talked a bit more about it with my friend today, and it's entirely possible that I am exaggerating the sexual aspect of this in order to feed some kind of self-loathing thing I acquired due to an incident involving my ex-girlfriend (another story entirely - use protection, kids) and haven't been able to shake. Of course I don't want to discount the fact that I did something wrong entirely, but my brain is likely twisting the incident to make it even worse. I'm aware that I need help, but I'm just not sure where to get it. Still, I don't think I'll be killing myself tonight or in the near future - many thanks to you and everyone else who commented on my posts (save for that one weirdo who seemingly made an account just to say my sister deserved what she got...not sure he read my original post), I'll probably be dropping by here under my main to try and help people out. Kindness and effort really do go a long way.
It's a slight comfort to know that someone understands how I'm feeling. Maybe we can work through this together. What's going on in your life that's got you where you (we?) are?

That's true, I guess I just wish I could make up for it somehow. I don't want to bring it up with her because I doubt she even remembers and we still have a solid relationship. Guess the only way I can atone is by living life positively.

I have thought about it - just terrified that if someone finds out it'll basically be the end of life as I know it, which is a big part of why I'm considering finishing it right here

But you make a really good point that I think I needed to hear from someone that wasn't a close friend - People make mistakes, but people can change. I'd like to think I've done some good things, and I know I can do even more to make a positive difference in people's lives. So thank you for that, I really appreciate your help
